before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate to one total per month across regions.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('month', as_index=False)[['revenue', 'orders']].sum()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
ax.plot(monthly['month'], monthly['revenue'], marker='o', label='Revenue')
ax.plot(monthly['month'], monthly['orders'], marker='s', label='Orders')
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Total (revenue / orders)')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.set_title('Monthly Revenue and Orders')
ax.legend()
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
